summary: Runtime module ownership, integration points, audit write rules, CLI/TUI entry points, stub/implemented boundaries, and duplicate-stack prohibitions are defined.

acceptance.criterion: Each planned runtime module has one owner and one integration point.
Existing MVP modules are reused instead of forked.
acceptance.evidence: ownership matrix maps ToolRouter, PolicyEvaluator, AuditJournal, SandboxExecutor, Rollback manager, RecoveryReconciler, TUI, and Safety suite to existing crates/agentd/src modules.

acceptance.criterion: The plan clearly separates in-process library calls from future IPC boundaries.
acceptance.evidence: runtime-module-ownership.md states first implementation remains in-process inside agentd and future IPC is deferred.

acceptance.criterion: Testing responsibility is assigned per module.
acceptance.evidence: ownership matrix includes a Test owner column for every runtime responsibility.
